basic_info.description: Welcome to this serene mid-century-style corner condo, with newly updated floors, appliances, and finishes throughout. Upon entering this top floor unit, you're greeted by a wall of built-in closets and an open-concept kitchen, overlooking the living spaces. The dining area features a wet bar, perfect for entertaining, preparing a morning coffee, or a nightcap. The living room is highlighted by floor-to-ceiling windows, exposed beams, and a dramatic fireplace. A split floor plan offers private bedrooms with walk-in closets, while a large, remodeled bath with new fixtures completes this home. Ample Diamond Heights Village amenities include a heated outdoor pool, fitness center, dry sauna, hot tub, clubhouse with WiFi and billiards, on-site management, walking paths with bridges and a koi pond, and easily accessible laundry facilities. An incredible value, this unit comes with elevator access, a gated one-car parking space, and a prime location close to Diamond Heights Shopping Center conveniences, freeway access, Glen Canyon Park, BART, bus lines, and nature galore!
